name: Arizona

jury_list.statute: A.R.S. 21-312: juror records are closed (juror information and jury questionnaire answers are not public; release only as the statute or the court allows).
jury_list.holder: Jury commissioner / superior court. Juror non-citizen notices go to the Secretary of State and county recorder (A.R.S. 21-314(F)).
jury_list.official_pipeline: A.R.S. 21-314(F): the jury commissioner reports persons who say they are not U.S. citizens to the Secretary of State and the county recorder. A.R.S. 16-165(A)(10): the county recorder sends notice; if no satisfactory proof of citizenship within 35 days, the recorder cancels the registration and notifies the county attorney and the attorney general.

sources.cite: A.R.S. 21-314 (jury commissioner reports non-citizens to SoS and county recorder)
A.R.S. 16-165(A)(10) (recorder notice, 35 days, cancellation, referral to county attorney and AG)

voter_file.who_may_get: Any person, on request to the county recorder or Secretary of State, but only for a use the statute allows (A.R.S. 16-168(E)).
voter_file.permitted_uses: Political, campaign, election and redistricting purposes, or other uses authorized by law. Commercial use is barred (A.R.S. 16-168(E)).
voter_file.penalty: A.R.S. 16-168(F): a person who posts precinct lists or registration data on the internet, or who uses or allows use for a purpose not authorized, is guilty of a class 6 felony.

private_challenge.who: At the polls only: any qualified elector of the county may orally challenge a person offering to vote (A.R.S. 16-591). That is contact with the voter at a polling place. JuryRoll does not support it.
private_challenge.form_or_statute: A.R.S. 16-591, 16-592 (challenge at the polls); A.R.S. 16-121.01(B) (presumption of valid registration; clear and convincing evidence to overcome it).
private_challenge.evidence_standard: A.R.S. 16-121.01(B): a registered person is presumed properly registered; a challenger must show clear and convincing evidence.

county_board.name: County recorders and election offices (Arizona Secretary of State directory)
county_board.note: The county recorder receives jury non-citizen notices under A.R.S. 21-314(F).

ag.name: Arizona Attorney General
ag.note: The recorder refers unresolved cases to the AG and county attorney (A.R.S. 16-165(A)(10)).

gates.basis: Juror records are closed (A.R.S. 21-312), so the jury list is not available to a private person. No pre-election private registration challenge statute was found; the only private challenge is at the polls (A.R.S. 16-591), which JuryRoll does not support. Strict gates: counts only.

notes: allowed is null: Arizona law lets an elector challenge at the polls (A.R.S. 16-591). No written pre-election challenge by a private person was found. The app treats null as no challenge guidance.
Duplication: the official pipeline already exists (A.R.S. 21-314(F) and 16-165(A)(10)). Aggregate referral should ask whether it ran.
dob_in_public_file is null: 16-168 restricts some identifying data; the exact DOB rule for purchased lists was not confirmed. The app treats null as no DOB.
Posting registration data on the internet is a class 6 felony (A.R.S. 16-168(F)). JuryRoll never posts data.
state_extra_days is 0: no state window that starts before day 90 was found in the reviewed challenge statutes.
